rows.grounds: compound of nānā, tīrtha, and jala in instrumental singular
causative optative form of root snā
compound of para and devatā in accusative singular

items.question: With what water should the supreme deity be bathed?
items.inference: Ritual bathing of the supreme deity uses waters from many tīrthas.
items.plain_english: Indeed, one should bathe the supreme deity with water from various pilgrimage places.
